own_tax.note: RREO "impostos" includes IRRF retained by the municipality (art. 158 I); the PEC 188 test used IPTU, ISS and ITBI only, so these shares are upper bounds.

councillors.note: Upper bounds: the caps are maxima; councils fix pay below them and may have fewer seats.

comissariado.cnu_2024_federal_vacancies_note: ATPS 500, EPPGG 150 in the 2024 national exam

new_party.note: Under current rules only parties above the art. 17 §3 threshold receive the FP: 2.5% of valid votes (or 13 deputies) in 2026 and 3% (or 15 deputies) from 2030; the party is assumed to pass it.
